name: 85395 · Goodyear, AZ
findings: ZIP 85395 (Goodyear) has 100 nonprofit organizations. 41 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 37 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 85395 (Goodyear) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
27% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 85395 (Goodyear) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 53% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 36 organizations here; 44% of all organizations here have no identified type.
